Prague Castle ( Czech : Pražský hrad ; [ˈpraʃskiː ˈɦrat] ) is a castle complex in Prague , Czech Republic serving as the official residence and workplace of the president of the Czech Republic . Built in the 9th century, the castle has long served as the seat of power for kings of Bohemia , Holy Roman emperors , and presidents of Czechoslovakia . As such, the term "Prague Castle" or simply " Hrad " ("the Castle") are often used as metonymy for the president and his staff and advisors. The Bohemian Crown Jewels are kept within a hidden room inside it.
